question: With B20 raised to 4000000 (C 50000 and the certify/16e code unchanged), does certify/16e decide any of 24 fresh 20-state worlds, stay sound there (non-vacuously), deterministic and wall-free inside a 3600 s run? Separately, can a repeated-reading majority front end (certify/16n, wrapping certify/16e) keep WRONG = 0 on 12-state worlds whose readings are flipped iid with eps = 0.05, at a declared failure probability delta = 0.001?

hypotheses.H1: certify/16e at B20 = 4000000 stays wall-free at family_bound 20: the 30 s chunk guard and 600 s case guard fire 0 times on every record
hypotheses.H2: two independent passes give byte-identical canon16e records on every case run twice
hypotheses.H3: scale20: WRONG = 0 and every decided record audited true at bound 20; at least 1 of 24 decided, so the soundness gate is non-vacuous (the decided count beyond 1 is reported, not predicted)
hypotheses.H4: noise12 (exploratory API): certify/16n issues no WRONG certificate on 12 noisy 12-state worlds; its decided count is reported, not predicted
hypotheses.H5: on clean 12-state traces with eps = 0 and k = 1, certify/16n reproduces certify/16e records exactly (compatibility)

design.api: no change to certify/16e (frozen in FREEZE_049). One additive module brute/api/certify16n.py (certify/16n, Certifier16N): each observation is read k times; the majority bit is fed to an unchanged certify/16e instance. k is chosen per trace length T from a declared eps_bar = 0.10 and delta = 0.001 so that T * exp(-2 k (0.5 - eps_bar)^2) <= delta (Hoeffding plus union bound, Exact under the iid model), k odd. A certificate is exact conditional on every majority being correct; under iid flips with eps <= eps_bar this holds with probability >= 1 - delta (Exact bound, conditional on the attested noise model). Host-agnostic: no I/O, threads, subprocess or os in brute/; no frozen file edited
design.reread_assumption: the noisy-world interface lets the identifier re-read the current observation without acting, each reading flipped independently. Whether the frozen noise generators (worlds_026 lineage) offer this is Open and is checked at build; if not, a new noisy 12-state world module with that interface is added (new file) and declared in the pre-run deviation before any 050 seed is used
design.cap_rule: fixed NOW, before any 050 data, from sealed 049 results only (Exact): C = 50000 (049, 0 guard firings, max chunk 14.4 s); B20 = 4000000 (Inferred: 4000000 / 8766 per s = 456 s, inside the 600 s case guard with 24 % margin; 4x the 049 spend); B12 for noise12 = 1500000 (the B16 value; 12-state cases were cheap in earlier studies). Not calibrated, not tuned

next_if_pass: all headline gates pass: certify/16e becomes certified for declared N <= 20 at B20 4000000 (exact conditional on the declared N and noise-free readings), and certify/16n is certified for declared N <= 12 under iid flips with eps <= 0.10 at failure probability <= delta; next, a noise study at 16 states and a scale-24 probe
next_if_fail: GDET50 fails with 0 guard firings: resume or the majority front end is not deterministic; find the source, ship nothing new. GDET50 or GQB25 fails on guard firings: B20 is too large for the case guard on this host; re-plan B20 from this run's slowest rate. GFID50 or GCOMPAT16N fails: the wrapper is unfaithful; fix it, ship nothing new. GS20_sound50 or GN12_sound fails on WRONG: soundness first; do not scale further. GS20_sound50 fails on non-vacuity only (0/24 decided, WRONG 0): record that 20 states are out of reach at 4000000 conflicts; the next step is a structural change (symmetry breaking or a better encoding), not more budget. G_RT fails: publish it; the noise study gets its own version

claim_scope: conditional on the declared N: an ID or IDF means unique among machines with at most N states consistent with the (majority-corrected, for certify/16n) trace. Inferred reason: a larger machine can copy the true machine on every visited state and differ only where the trace never reaches, so a size bound is inherent. certify/16n claims are further conditional on the iid noise model with eps <= eps_bar and hold with probability >= 1 - delta
